acceptance: the platform serves getIntegrationStatus from its own bounded read, not by widening the deal workspace projection
the read resolves an active DealParticipant in a VERIFIED organization inside the caller's tenant before touching outbox rows
the query runs inside the trusted RLS context, never on the untrusted client
the select list excludes payload, lastError, lease columns, idempotencyKey and triggeredByUserId
the entry list is bounded and reports returnedCount and truncated
countsByStatus and deadLetterCount are aggregated across the whole deal, not derived from the returned page
the tool is registered in the argument contract, the planner intent catalogue and the policy registry together
forbidden_capabilities: outbox mutation, redrive or lease acquisition from a tool path
model bundle, benchmark, admission authority or runtime-host changes
UI, routing, feature-flag or deployment changes
planner catalogue version changes, which are pinned by the 0014 migration CHECK constraint
